newsitem.title: USA: Carolina sees S.C. nuke out until Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: Carolina sees S.C. nuke out until Oct 15.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co's 683 megawatt (MW) Robinson 2 nuclear unit was taken off the grid late Saturday to begin its 37-day refueling outage, the company said Monday.

"It was postponed by 24 hours due to Fran," a company spokesman said, referring to the absence of many employees because of last week's hurricane. "The unit was off the grid at 11:13 (2313 EDT) Saturday night."
The unit, located in Hartsville, S.C., and generating 10 percent of CP&L's overall power output, is slated to return to service on October 15.
